title: Every Major Game Releasing in November That Isn't GTA 6
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 isn't the only game coming out in November. Discover what games are daring to share space with Rockstar's latest release.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Beyond GTA6: November's Other Major Releases

When Rockstar Games prepares to launch a title as monumental as Grand Theft Auto 6, the entire gaming landscape tends to hold its breath. Industry watchers often assume that no publisher would dare schedule a release anywhere near the window of a new GTA game. However, according to recent reporting from Polygon, GTA6 is not the only game coming out in November.

## Daring to Share the Spotlight

For many developers and publishers, sharing a release window with a juggernaut like Rockstar's latest project might sound like commercial suicide. Yet, the November lineup proves that some titles are still willing to enter the arena. These games are daring to share space with GTA6, appealing to players who might be looking for alternative experiences or specific genres that complement or contrast the open-world crime epic.

Whether these titles can successfully carve out a profitable audience amidst the overwhelming media coverage of GTA6 remains one of the most interesting market dynamics of the season. Gamers looking past the massive hype surrounding Rockstar's newest title will still find a handful of options hitting store shelves and digital storefronts this November.

## Editor's Take

It takes a bold publisher to launch a game in the same month as GTA6. Whether they are targeting a completely different niche or simply sticking to their planned schedules regardless of the competition, November is shaping up to be much busier than a typical one-horse race.
